title: Figures 2-3: MEMS micromachine gears on bioelectrodes and MEMS motor schematic
description: Figure 2 is a color micrograph of "Functional MEMS Micromachines Attached to Sensing Bioelectrodes," showing gear wheels, a linkage and a long shaft; the caption notes gear features as small as 50 microns. Figure 3, "Schematic Diagram of a MEMS Motor Complete With a Method of Converting Oscillatory Motion to Linear Motion," shows comb-drive banks and a central shaft, with a pink micrograph inset of the device above. Both are credited to the ASU Bioengineering Department.
